images.caption: Marriott built this and another theme park and called them Great America, each opening in 1976. But Marriott got out of the business, and after a messy process involving a land developer,  the city of Santa Clara, and a bunch of lawsuits, the park ended up being run by Kings Entertainment. Later Paramount bought Kings and more recently, Paramount sold its parks to Cedar Fair L.P., the current owner.
images.alt: Marriott built this and another theme park and called them Great America, each opening in 1976. But Marriott got out of the business, and after a messy process involving a land developer,  the city of Santa Clara, and a bunch of lawsuits, the park ended up being run by Kings Entertainment. Later Paramount bought Kings and more recently, Paramount sold its parks to Cedar Fair L.P., the current owner.

images.filename: 2000 Victoria registration plate RGU 469 The Place to Be.jpg
images.caption: General issue vehicle registration plate of Victoria, Australia. This particular registration plate has the combination RGU-469, from late 2001 as per VicRoads [1]. This plate is of standard size and incorporates the slogan "Victoria – The Place to Be" as issued from 17 October 2000 starting at QNG-100. Photographed at an Australian-themed restaurant at California's Great America, Santa Clara, California, United States.
